lines.beaver: 이번 주말에 유적지 답사 가자. 뭘 보고 싶어?
lines.beaver_en: Let's go see a historic site this weekend. What do you want to see?
lines.beaver_roman: ibeon jumare yujeokji dapsa gaja. mwol bogo sipeo?
lines.learner: 고려 시대 유적지에 가 보고 싶어.
lines.en: I want to visit a Goryeo-era historic site.
lines.roman: goryeo sidae yujeokjie ga bogo sipeo.

lines.beaver_en: Great! They say the museum there has lots of treasures.
lines.en: Whether treasures or paintings, I want to see it all.

lines.beaver_en: Goryeo went through a lot of wars, you know.
lines.learner: 맞아, 전쟁 영웅 이야기도 듣고 싶어.
lines.en: Right, I want to hear stories of war heroes too.
lines.roman: maja, jeonjaeng yeongung iyagido deutgo sipeo.

lines.beaver_en: Right, the war with the Mongols was really long.
lines.learner: 그 시대 사람들 정말 대단했던 것 같아.
lines.en: The people of that era must have been amazing.
lines.roman: geu sidae saramdeul jeongmal daedanhaetdeon geot gata.

lines.beaver: 근처에 고려 공주 이야기가 있는 절도 있어.
lines.beaver_en: Nearby there's also a temple with a story about a Goryeo princess.
lines.beaver_roman: geuncheoe goryeo gongju iyagiga inneun jeoldo isseo.
lines.learner: 공주 이야기? 그 절도 꼭 가 보자.
lines.en: A princess story? Let's definitely visit that temple too.
lines.roman: gongju iyagi? geu jeoldo kkok ga boja.

lines.beaver_en: By the way, should we go by bus or by train?
lines.learner: 버스든지 기차든지 빨리 가는 걸로 하자.
lines.en: Bus or train, let's take whichever is faster.
lines.roman: beoseudeunji gichadeunji ppalli ganeun geollo haja.

lines.beaver: 기차가 더 빨라. 표는 내가 예매할게.
lines.beaver_en: The train is faster. I'll book the tickets.
lines.beaver_roman: gichaga deo ppalla. pyoneun naega yemaehalge.
lines.learner: 고마워. 세계 최초의 금속 활자도 보고 싶어.
lines.en: Thanks. I also want to see the world's first metal type.
lines.roman: gomawo. segye choechoui geumsok hwaljado bogo sipeo.

lines.beaver: 좋아. 고대 유적지도 하나 더 갈까?
lines.beaver_en: Okay. Should we visit one more ancient site too?
lines.beaver_roman: joa. godae yujeokjido hana deo galkka?
lines.en: Yes, I've been curious about ancient history too.

lines.beaver: 가서 역사 이야기 더 많이 하자.
lines.beaver_en: Let's talk a lot more about history when we get there.
lines.beaver_roman: gaseo yeoksa iyagi deo mani haja.
lines.learner: 좋아. 비가 와도 꼭 가서 이야기하자.
lines.en: Sure. Even if it rains, let's go and talk there.
lines.roman: joa. biga wado kkok gaseo iyagihaja.

lines.beaver: 좋아! 그럼 토요일 아침에 역에서 만나.
lines.beaver_en: Great! Then let's meet at the station Saturday morning.
lines.beaver_roman: joa! geureom toyoil achime yeogeseo manna.
lines.learner: 응, 드디어 계획 다 세웠다! 토요일에 봐.
lines.en: Okay, we finally finished the plan! See you Saturday.
lines.roman: eung, deudieo gyehoek da sewotda! toyoire bwa.
